issues.title: Ugandan farmers count heavy losses as drought withers crops, weakens livestock
issues.title_en: Ugandan farmers count heavy losses as drought withers crops, weakens livestock
issues.summary: Masaka, Uganda | URN | Farmers across Uganda are counting heavy losses as a prolonged dry spell withers crops, dries up water sources and leaves livestock struggling for pasture and water. The extreme weather is also threatening household incomes and food security. Across several regions, farmers who invested heavily in coffee, maize, beans, sorghum and ...
